title: the jollar dollar tollar pollar
description: texture pack for written book based money on an SMP
body:
Texture pack for custom written book based money on an SMP

Works without any mods on 1.21.5+

Rename any book to:
- "1 Jollar" for the copper coin
- "10 Jollars" for the silver coin
- "100 Jollars" for the gold coin
- "1000 Jollars" for the netherite coin

It's Dollar but with a J for some reason
